anchored.event: Anchored(uint64 indexed epoch, uint64 indexed hourStart, uint64 size, bytes32 root, bytes32 stateRoot, uint8 kind)
anchored.note: Frozen event shape. v0 emits kind 0 only. Readers fetch by topic0 plus the indexed epoch and hourStart. topic0 is keccak256 of the canonical signature.
